LESSON: ENTERPRISE PROJECT AT SCHOOL

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Resources And Economic Activities
Topic 4.3: Enterprise Project at school
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 9

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Enterprise Project at school, part of Resources And Economic Activities in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four SOCIAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: How can enterprise projects be initiated and managed? 2. How does the enterprise project at school benefit?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Enterprise Project at school together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: learners display teamwork as they contribute to group decisions by actively planning for a

viable enterprise project at school.

● Learning to learn: learners exhibit self-discipline as they work collaboratively in managing the project enterprise.

● Digital Literacy: learners connect using technology as they use digital or print resources to search for enterprise projects

undertaken in schools.

Values:
● Responsibility: learners develop hard work as they engage in the assigned roles and duties as they undertake the enterprise

project at school and evaluate its success

● Integrity: learners develop accountability as they participate in the initiation and management of the enterprise project in the

school

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs) :

● Creative and critical thinking: learners undertake the enterprise project at school, evaluate its success, and participate in the

school entrepreneurship week.

● Humility and simplicity: learners do not show off or despise others as they share responsibilities on the planned enterprise

project.

Links to other Learning Areas:
Mathematics: as learners discuss in groups ethical practices to be observed in managing the enterprise project (money, final

products).

Suggested Learning Resources

digital and print devices, approved textbooks, KSL Dictionary, real objects, display boards,
